_comment: Controls the 'contribute your numbers' form on /benchmarks/. Showing how the data is collected is the point: a reader can see the instrument, which is what separates a real benchmark from an invented one. To switch from the email fallback to a hosted form, set provider to 'jotform' and paste the form URL into formUrl — the page will embed it instead.
closesNote: Responses collected on a rolling basis. The next edition publishes in July 2027.
privacyNote: We ask for a title and either an organization or a LinkedIn profile so we can confirm responses come from real fundraising professionals rather than automated submissions. Verification details are never published, never shared, and are deleted once the edition is finalized. Only aggregate figures appear in the results.
